messages:
ana: Morning — flagging a regression after we started quantizing q4b-lite on long-context prompts. Prompt set seems to have skewed towards instruction-heavy examples.

sam: :eyes: Can you paste the failing examples? Is this the same promptset from the last golden refresh?

ana: It's the 'long-instr-anchor' shard from last week's hopper. Short excerpt:
```
System: extract entities from long customer complaint
User: ... 600 tokens of context ...
```
Model (q4b-int8): drops product SKUs, hallucinated dates.

eli: Did we change dedupe thresholds for anchors? Last time we increased fuzzy threshold which might bias out tail examples.

ana: We kept dedupe at 0.92 but applied new unicode normalization. I suspect quantization+norm interact.

mahmoud: Repro steps?

ana: Local repro command:
```
./bench_onboard.sh --model q4b-int8 --prompts samples/long-instr-anchor/1000.jsonl --seed 42 --max-tokens 512
```
Outputs attached in thread.

jess: We should snapshot a smaller golden subset that targets NER/slot coverage before we tweak quant knobs. I can carve a 200-sample balanced golden set if labeling capacity available.

sam: Label capacity = ~80/day right now. @label-bot can we expedite 4 reviewers for a two-day sprint?

label-bot: scheduling request received. ETA to assign reviewers: 3.5 hours. Will prioritize 'golden-ner-longctx' queue if confirmed.

ana: Confirmed. I'll produce sampling query for balanced golden (stratify by token_length buckets + entity-type). Proposed SQL:
```
SELECT * FROM prompt_bank
WHERE domain='support' AND length BETWEEN 200 AND 1200
ORDER BY RANDOM()
GROUP BY entity_type
LIMIT 200;
```

eli: Also add a tiny holdout of adversarial paraphrases (20 samples) to catch hallucinations.

mahmoud: Plan: carve golden 200 + adv20, label for NER/slots in 48h, run q4b-int8 vs q4b-fp16 on the golden, compute span-F1 and hallucination rate, then decide whether to adjust quant params (per-channel float fallback) or increase KV cache precision.

ana: I'll kick off the sampling and attach the prompt ids. Thanks y'all :thumbsup:

sam: Great — ping me when samples are ready. I'll run the bench and diff scripts: `tools/eval/diff_golden.py --baseline q4b-fp16 --candidate q4b-int8`
